content.text: Brunch FE-1175 scope-handoff proof. The selected spec already has accepted upstream anchors: REQ1 is the settled requirement, AC1 is its settled executable criterion, MOD1 is the settled design module, and CH1 is the settled verification check. Use read_graph in overview mode to inspect existing node codes. Then use present_review_set exactly once to propose one plan-lens scope handoff package that the executor could consume directly. Proposal constraints: create one frontier and one scope; compose the scope under the frontier; link existing REQ1 to the scope with realization, compose existing MOD1 under the scope, and link existing AC1 and CH1 to the scope with dependency; use schemaVersion 1, lens "plan", epistemicStatus "asserted", and non-empty grounding/pitch fields; do not call mutate_graph directly; stop after a successful present_review_set so the external Brunch RPC reviewer can approve it.

content.text:
## Proposal: FE-1175 Scope Handoff: Selected Spec Entry

> Packages the settled intent, design, and verification anchors for the selected-spec entry flow into a single executor-facing scope under a plan frontier. The scope carries the realization link from REQ1, composes MOD1 as the design unit, and depends on AC1 and CH1 as the acceptance and verification gates.

- __$F1: FE-1175 Selected Spec Entry — Execution Frontier__
  
  Owns the scope handoff for the selected-spec orientation feature. Gate: scope d-scope is accepted and executor-ready.
- __$SCP1: Selected Spec Entry — Execution Scope__
  
  Executor-facing handoff package. Deliver a selected-spec entry summary renderer (MOD1) satisfying REQ1, verified by CH1, and accepted by AC1.
  - part of __$F1__
    
    > The scope lives under the frontier as its single execution-facing handoff package.
  - realizes __REQ1__
    
    > REQ1 is realized by this scope; the scope is the committed delivery unit for that requirement.
  - depends on __AC1__
    
    > AC1 is an acceptance gate; the scope depends on it being satisfied before closure.
  - depends on __CH1__
    
    > CH1 is the verification check; the scope depends on it passing before closure.

Other new edges:

- __MOD1__ part of __$SCP1__
  
  > MOD1 is the design unit composed under this scope.
